question: Duralumin is an alloy made up of aluminium and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Duralumin** is an **alloy** primarily** made up of aluminum along with copper, manganese, and smaller amounts of magnesium and other elements.**
 
• The exact composition can vary, but typically it consists of around **90% aluminum, 4% copper, 1% manganese, and 1% magnesium. **
 
• The remaining percentage includes trace amounts of other elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Tin** is a versatile metal with a long history of use in human civilization.
 
 
• Its** low toxicity, corrosion resistance, and malleability make** it valuable in various applications, particularly in the **packaging industry and as an alloying element in bronze and solder.**
 
 
 
• **Zinc** is a versatile element with significant industrial and biological importance.
 
 
• Its **corrosion resistance, electrical conductivity, and beneficial properties make it valuable in a wide range of applications, from corrosion protection to nutrition and healthcare.**
